task.title: Work with Submodules
task.shortdesc: The Git Client initializes, clones, and updates submodules for you as you work.

context.p: A submodule is a repository nested inside another. The Git Client handles most of the bookkeeping automatically:

ul.li: Cloning a repository initializes and clones its submodules.
Pulling updates the submodules, when Update all submodules after pulling changes from the remote repository is selected in the preferences.
Checking out a branch checks out its submodules at the recorded commit.

step.cmd:
To open a submodule as the working copy, open the menu and select (enabled only when the repository contains submodules), or select Open on a modified submodule in the
area.

p.note: The tooltip (via hover) for a modified submodule shows both the currently tracked commit and the previously tracked commit.
